LESSON: SELF-AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.1: Self-awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Self-awareness. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how friends?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate his/her body as a temple other as brothers, sisters and part of Paramatma. of God’s creation. 1.2 Panch Mahabhoot

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate his/her body as a temple other as brothers, sisters and part of Paramatma. of God’s creation. 1.2 Panch Mahabhoot
   In simple words: practise until you can appreciate his/her body as a temple other as brothers, sisters and part of Paramatma. of God’s creation. 1.2 Panch Mahabhoot. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Self-awareness using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Self-awareness in the examples.
2. Explain Self-awareness to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Self-awareness.
4. Show that you can: appreciate his/her body as a temple other as brothers, sisters and part of Paramatma. of God’s creation. 1.2 Panch Mahabhoot

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Self-awareness using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Self-awareness important for a Grade 3 learner?
